meta.inputs_note: CICIoMT2024 tables: nfstream version NOT RECORDED for the stored run (see step 01); CICIoT2023 tables: nfstream 6.6.0, stage2a sha256 241e5654.., per manifest.jsonl

what: Flows per dataset, files per dataset, raw and deduplicated counts per class and per pair, benign share, and a benign-capture audit. Rows measured on: every flow of every listed file (profiling captures excluded for CICIoMT2024 by stage2c's EXCLUDE_SUBSTR).

dedup.order_caveat: cross-class duplicate vectors are attributed to the first file in sort order; per-class dedup_global counts depend on it. dedup_within_label is order-free.

labelling_of_benign_background_in_attack.CICIoMT2024: label = filename class for every flow (stage2c_dedup.py L51,L56 via stage2_device_disjoint.filename_to_class L44); background benign flows inside an attack pcap are labelled as that attack. The dataset README (WiFi_and_MQTT attacks, 1 page) says nothing about benign background.
labelling_of_benign_background_in_attack.CICIoT2023: label = class of the pcap from ciciot23_files.tsv -> manifest.jsonl (run_ciciot23.py), applied to every flow of the file; same consequence. How the OFFICIAL CICIoT2023 CSVs label such flows was not checked here.

CICIoMT2024.contiguity_rule: consecutive files are one chunk-chain if |first_flow - previous last_flow| <= 60 s (my threshold, flagged)

CICIoT2023.contiguity_rule: consecutive files are one chunk-chain if |first_flow - previous last_flow| <= 60 s (my threshold, flagged)
